shared_elements: relief motifs arranged in horizontal zones or registers
justification: The most specific visible correspondence is that both are upright stone faces with low-relief imagery organized at least partly into horizontal zones, with some animal-like profile forms near the lower portions. The biggest difference is that A is densely and crisply carved with clearly separated animals and patterned bands, while B is much more eroded and appears dominated by a single central vertical figure or mass with only faint surrounding motifs.
